Body.Content:
What and why

We are introducing support for using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Microsoft Copilot Notebooks. This enhancement allows users to add structured lists and tabular data directly to notebooks alongside existing document types. By including CSV and TSV content as reference material, Copilot can generate more relevant and informed outputs such as presentations, reports, briefs, and other content grounded in both structured and unstructured data.

Rollout schedule

  • Public Preview (Worldwide): Rollout has completed.
  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout began in mid-October 2026 and is expected to complete by late October 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations with Microsoft 365 Copilot and access to Copilot Notebooks in OneNote.
  • Users who work with CSV and TSV files as part of their Copilot workflows.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft OneNote
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Copilot Notebooks

What will happen

  • Users will be able to add CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks.
  • Copilot will use data contained in these files alongside other referenced content when generating responses and content.
  • The feature will be enabled automatically for tenants that already allow Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files. No additional configuration will be required.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required. We recommend that you notify users who work with structured data that they can reference CSV and TSV files directly within Copilot Notebooks once the feature becomes available.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: Microsoft OneNote now supports using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enhancing content generation with structured data. The feature is globally available since mid-October 2026, requires no user action, and automatically enables for tenants with existing CSV/TSV Copilot permissions.
